name: Church Leaders
overview: Scripture reveals that church leaders are divinely appointed overseers entrusted with the care and feeding of God's church, purchased by Christ's own blood (Acts 20:28). Their roles include apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers, each serving to equip the body of Christ (Ephesians 4:11). Leaders are to be set in order and ordained with clear responsibility for guiding the congregation (Titus 1:5), and believers are instructed to remember, follow, and obey those who rule over them, recognizing their accountability to God and the spiritual oversight they provide (Hebrews 13:7, 13:17).
